cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll lend you the ladder if helping earns me first choice of barbecue food.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't it just be a favour?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Certainly. What does the favour redeem for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Is friendship available before the sausages run out?

mechanism: A defines and schedules the repayment value of a favor, using expert bargaining to price even friendship.
confusable: D200 increases a wager; D214 attaches a trade or reward to any request.
comparison: Property loan and meal access differ from reciprocal apology risk.
seedUse: Keep friendship offer but translate it into an actual reciprocal action rather than a sausage joke.
